groups.decision: Keep declared product applicability, matching purpose and eligible role descriptions separate. None proves effective target authorization or feature availability.

Enterprise creator-only editing, dry runs and enablement coexist with repository administration requirements. Enterprise ownership does not automatically establish organization or repository dry-run authority.
Distinguish edit-induced alert closure, non-alert-generating dry run and reviewed publication. Editing alone is not successful publication or erasure.
Require an explicit alert-handling choice and asynchronous completion evidence. Pinned UI terminology is ambiguous; preserve the alert-deletion conflict record rather than map close to erase.
Preserve enterprise, organization and repository prerequisites individually. Organization policy and ordinary secret-scanning enablement do not alone establish effective repository push protection.
Two equivalent published-pattern visibility assertions retain their distinct source occurrences; a visible enable button is not observed blocking.
Repeated disruption warnings are one shared risk proposition with three retained source occurrences. Dry-run and false-positive assessment remain required proposal evidence.
Retain scope-specific UI steps and optional enablement strength. Enablement, disablement, pattern removal and actual enforcement are distinct states.
Resolve the owning scope and exact pattern before navigating; a similarly named pattern in another scope is not equivalent evidence.
Preserve mutually exclusive GHES and cloud navigation branches. Policy-area product labels remain unresolved dependencies, not hardcoded universal selectors.
Retain the nested organization Settings include and fallback menu; a fallback locates a tab but does not bypass role requirements.
Keep repository selection, Settings fallback and feature-conditioned security label distinct. The fpt/ghec feature declaration must not be generalized to GHES without actual version resolution.

AI generation feature/version and pinned preview context remain distinct from authoring input and optional sample strings. No real-secret submission, AI activation, accuracy or current availability inferred.

Retain organization-owned Team/Enterprise entitlement, repository Secret Protection prerequisite, organization scanning target set, GHES-only enterprise prerequisite and creator-only authority separately. Product metadata and enterprise ownership do not prove effective actor access or approve feature/cost changes.

Pattern name, regex, surrounding requirements, sample testing and new-pattern operation are independent inputs. An example match cannot certify recall, false-positive rate, production safety or correct enforcement.

Dry runs intentionally generate no alerts. Preserve exact pattern revision, selected repository set, all-organization alternative, ten-repository selection limits and 1,000-result display sample. Retest changed expressions; sample results and screenshots cannot certify complete matches, enterprise coverage or completed testing.

Successful dry run, explicit publication, visible Enable control and optional scope-specific push enablement remain separate states. Publication and generic post-creation scanning are not observed push blocking.

Retain entire-history/all-present-branch description within the eligible repository set and independent alert-recipient/access assertions. Enterprise description explicitly excludes repositories without Secret Protection; no scan completion, notification delivery, credential revocation or absent-branch coverage inferred.

required_parameters: credential type and intended detection purpose
authorized reviewer and accountable response owner
read_only_evidence: effective feature availability and actor permissions
enterprise and repository effective push-protection settings
response and revocation procedure with accountable ownership
binding_proposal.behavior_evidence: Separate approved positive, negative and bypass tests must show actual blocking for the chosen pattern and repository. Settings alone cannot PASS an enforcement binding.
binding_proposal.mutation_boundary: No scanner, permission, protection or deletion change is authorized by this proposal. A future approved plan/diff/apply/verify adapter must use explicit alert handling and concurrency-safe pattern identity; destructive defaults must not be inherited silently.
binding_proposal.unknown_handling: Missing access, unresolved versions, unavailable feature data and incomplete asynchronous processing remain UNKNOWN or MANUAL_REVIEW, never PASS.
binding_proposal.template_review_required: Credential-response and applicability templates need review before canonical adoption; PII handling, erasure and regulatory compliance require separate purpose-specific evidence.
binding_proposal.dry_run_contract: Retain exact expression revision and target-set inventory, total match count if authoritative data permits, displayed sample and truncation, positive/negative examples and false-positive review. Ten selected repositories and a 1,000-result display cap are not whole-estate or all-match certification; missing totals remain unverified. Retest after expression changes.

Review linked pattern-definition, push-protection, organization-security and enterprise-role pages
Inspect linked screenshots and determine their per-file rights
Resolve feature conditionals per published version and compare actual acquired bodies
Account for every article and reusable candidate plus non-candidate semantic content
Independent source-to-claim omission and atomic-fidelity audit
Review new pattern-details syntax, AI generation, dry-run result and selected-repository dependencies with complete candidate accounting
